title.zh: notiee 1.0.9 更新日志：把整个 App 重做了一遍
title.en: the notiee 1.0.9 changelog: i rebuilt almost the whole app

summary.zh: 四个 tab 变两个地方，相机、录音、编辑器全部重写，Notti 有了记忆和来源，免费版也有了账号和统一 AI 额度。
summary.en: four tabs became two places, the camera, recording and editor were all rebuilt, Notti gained memory and sources, and the free app now has accounts and one AI allowance.

title.zh: 最近的小世界，和树上的两颗苹果
title.en: little worlds lately, and two apples on the tree

summary.zh: dreamland 的新样子、异世界食堂、动动星球，还有从作品列表搬到树上的两个老项目。
summary.en: dreamland's new shape, a diner between worlds, dongdongplanet, and two older projects that moved onto the tree.

summary.zh: 我想能有个人陪陪我，在我累得要死、心里难受的时候能有个人跟我说说话。
summary.en: I just want someone around — someone to talk to when I'm exhausted and everything feels heavy.

title.en: what i've been up to lately

summary.zh: notiee+ 快上架了，聊聊 dreamland 的重做、idbettershua!、还有终于收到的第一个大厂 oc。
summary.en: notiee+ is almost live — plus dreamland's rebuild, a little quiz site, and my first big-tech offer call.

title.zh: 迟来的 notiee 1.0.5 更新日志

summary.zh: 纯文字记录、自动翻出相关笔记、日程彩色标签——这一版做了几件一直想做的事。
summary.en: plain text notes, auto-surfaced related notes, color tags for events — a few things i'd wanted to do for a while.

summary.zh: 给我的小网站加了个博客角落——这是它的第一篇。
summary.en: i gave my little site a blog-ish corner. this is its first note.
